description:
`DvbT2MotherCode` (`crates/gf2-coding/src/bch/dvb_t2/mod.rs`) is a newtype over `BinaryBchCode` that presents the canonical code under `SystematicLayout::MessageParityDescending` on all four block-code traits. The capability is generic: any `BchCode<X, S, M>` under any `SystematicLayout` could be viewed the same way, and a future standards family would need the same wrapper.

## Background

Surfaced by the DVB-T2 cutover (`@/issue/97410c80`), whose design row assigns layout declaration to standards constructors. A generic layout-declaring view in `bch/encode.rs` (or beside `SystematicLayout`) would let every standards constructor share one mechanism (`@/invariant/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One generic layout-declaring view over `BchCode<X, S, M>` implements the four canonical traits for a declared `SystematicLayout`, and `DvbT2MotherCode` is that view instantiated (or a thin alias of it) with its differential evidence unchanged.
title: Generalize the DVB-T2 layout-declaring view over BchCode
